name: SN 2020ssf field (Hubble)
blurb: A field around SN 2020ssf, a Type Ia supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2020ssffield-hubble
story: The site of SN 2020ssf, a Type Ia supernova. Hubble returned after the explosion to probe the surroundings of the star system that produced it.

claims.text: SN 2020ssf is a Type Ia supernova
Hubble program 16691 took late-time snapshots of recent transients, including SN2020SSF, to probe their surroundings
